A new fern frond often uncurls from a tight spiral.
A river is flowing water that can wear a path through the land.
A wetland is land saturated with water, though it may not stay wet all year.
Allosaurus was a meat-eating dinosaur with small horns above its eyes.
Ankylosaurus had bony armor and a heavy club at the end of its tail.
Brachiosaurus had front legs longer than its back legs.
Carnotaurus had two horns on top of its head and very small arms.
Corythosaurus was a duck-billed dinosaur with a helmet-shaped head crest.
Deserts get very little rain. Some deserts are cold, not hot.
Dilophosaurus had two bony crests on its head.
Ferns make spores instead of flowers or seeds.

Parasaurolophus had a long hollow head crest. It may have helped make sounds.
Plesiosaurs were marine reptiles, not dinosaurs.
Raindrops bend and reflect sunlight, spreading it into rainbow colours.
Rock beneath Earth’s surface is called magma. Once it erupts, it is called lava.
Search around the snowy tracks.
Search between the tall fern fronds.
Search under the quiet night sky.
Snowflakes are groups of ice crystals that grow inside cold clouds.
Spinosaurus had a tall sail on its back. Scientists still study what it was for.
Stegosaurus had bony plates along its back. Their exact purpose is still being studied.
T. rex had short arms and powerful jaws.
Triceratops had three horns and a large bony frill.
Velociraptor had a curved claw on each foot.
Water can slowly dissolve limestone and help form caves.
